scientific_integrity: A self-contained deduction of every ideal-power critical portrait using the published characteristic-zero CM-PCF parameter classification, exact algebraic-integer valuations, and Chinese remaindering; no claim of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The characteristic-zero classification is used as a published input.
The intrinsic field Q(c) and its ring of integers are essential; extensions of the base field rescale ideal-power thresholds.
Only the orbit of the marked critical point is classified, not the complete finite-ring functional graph.
Independent external mathematical audit not performed.
title: Critical-orbit portrait rigidity at every ideal for CM unicritical polynomials
